# Spicy Lyrics renderer

This directory contains code from [Spicy Lyrics](https://github.com/Spikerko/spicy-lyrics/).
The embedded animator, virtualizer, styles and supporting functions use release
6.5.10, commit `1c02f47cd64ed8c34bb76dd8ff00755db9d1d66f`. The original
JavaScript spring port and legacy standalone adapter were based on commit
`cc45160facbebbe6c872a8796d339c0602d58928`.

Copyright Spikerko and contributors. The included GNU Affero General Public
License v3.0 applies to this code. See `SPICY-LYRICS-NOTICE.md` for how the
renderer is connected to Monochrome.
